description: This Java class 'OverlayDataImpl' implements the 'OverlayData' interface and manages overlay color data such as primary, dark primary, accent, primary text, and secondary text colors. It provides constructors, getters, setters, a validation method, and a custom toString method for representing overlay color information.

classes.name: OverlayDataImpl
classes.description: Implementation of overlay color data management, including color properties, validation, and string representation.

methods.name: OverlayDataImpl
methods.description: Default constructor initializing all colors to zero.

methods.name: OverlayDataImpl
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing color fields with provided values.

methods.description: Checks if the overlay data is valid based on color differences.

methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the overlay data.
